text:
Situation: Digoxin 0.25 mg/mL injection (NDC 00641141035) labeled by Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. and manufactured at Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A., FEI 3002807173, has been on FDA's shortage list for 65 months as of 2026-10-21. Corvale General holds 14.5 days of the 0.25 mg/mL injection and can transfer 6 units to Corvale East, which holds 6.1 days, raising East to 7 days. Tablet inventory at both sites exceeds two weeks.

Why (FDA record): FDA records show the Hikma Portugal plant received an OAI classification on 2014-03-28 (inspection 876911) and a Warning Letter on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023 (two) were all classified VAI. A second registered plant for digoxin tablets, Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407), had an OAI inspection ending 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, with later inspections VAI through 2026-07-16. The product has not been listed on FDA's shortage list since 2021-06-04.

Our position: The injection shortage persists despite the Hikma plant's recent VAI history. Current stock supports a limited internal transfer to balance days on hand. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list today but lack verified manufacturing site transparency.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 6 units of digoxin 0.25 mg/mL, 2 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director.
2. Evaluate purchase from Covis Pharma US, Inc. (AZURITY plant) — approved by buyer.
3. Request manufacturing site disclosure from HF Acquisition Co LLC, Medical Purchasing Solutions, LLC, and ProPharma Distribution before purchase — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or formulary substitutions at this time.
